proposedchanges.title: Former FBI and CIA Director William Webster Urges Senate to Reject Patel and Gabbard
proposedchanges.description_long: On December 26, 2024, William Webster urged senators to reject Kash Patel’s nomination to lead the FBI and Tulsi Gabbard’s nomination to become director of national intelligence. Webster, a former director of both agencies, made his case in a letter that warned of risks he associated with the nominees. The supplied account does not describe the letter’s specific arguments or report how senators responded. The letter documents a former intelligence and law-enforcement official’s opposition during the confirmation debate; it does not establish that the nominees posed the predicted risks or determine the outcome of either nomination.
